stemMd: Which feature is shared by bacteria and human cells?
explanationMd: Both cell types translate messenger RNA using ribosomes, although their ribosomes differ in size and composition. Membrane-bound nuclei and mitochondria distinguish eukaryotic human cells from bacteria. Cell walls and chloroplasts are not universal cellular features.

distractorRationale.b: Neither bacteria nor human cells contain chloroplasts.
distractorRationale.d: Human cells lack cell walls, and bacterial walls are not generally cellulose.
